name: hotel-drogon-visual
description: Playwright visual-parity harness: compares converted React pages against captured legacy PHPRetro references.

scripts.test:visual:container: docker run --rm -i --network host -v "%cd%/../..:/repo:ro" -v "%cd%/.out:/out" -e BASE_NEW=http://localhost:3000 -e PLAYWRIGHT_ARGS=visual-parity.spec.ts mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble bash /repo/tests/e2e/run-in-container.sh
scripts.capture:container: docker run --rm -i --network host -v "%cd%/../..:/repo:ro" -v "%cd%/.out:/out" -v "%cd%/../../docs/reference-screenshots/baseline:/repo-baselines" -e BASE_LEGACY=http://localhost:8081 -e PLAYWRIGHT_ARGS=capture-references.spec.ts -e PLAYWRIGHT_CONFIG=playwright.capture.config.ts -e COPY_CAPTURED_TO=/repo-baselines mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble bash /repo/tests/e2e/run-in-container.sh
